stories.title: South Korea Demands Ukraine Apology Over Denial of Confidential Deal on North's POWs

en.title: South Korea Demands Ukraine Apology Over Denial of Confidential Deal on North's POWs
en.summary: South Korea's presidential office demanded an official apology from Ukraine for disclosing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war and then falsely denying that both sides had agreed to keep the arrangement confidential.

en.title: Saudi Defense Minister Discusses Defense Cooperation with Malaysian Counterpart
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's defense minister held discussions with Malaysia's defense minister regarding bilateral defense cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: South Korea demands apology from Ukraine over disclosure of North Korean PoW transfer

en.title: South Korea demands apology from Ukraine over disclosure of North Korean PoW transfer
en.summary: South Korea's presidential office demanded an official explanation and apology from Ukraine for unilaterally disclosing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war and subsequently denying a non-disclosure agreement existed.

stories.title: Klopp endures 1st loss as Greece beats Germany for the 1st time in Nations League

en.title: Klopp endures 1st loss as Greece beats Germany for the 1st time in Nations League
en.summary: Greece defeated Germany 1-0 in a Nations League match, marking both the team's first victory over Germany and Jürgen Klopp's first loss as Germany's coach. A deflected shot in the 74th minute secured the historic win for Greece.

en.summary: Israel's foreign minister announced the revocation of diplomatic credentials for Dutch officials in the West Bank, with a seven-day deadline to surrender their papers, citing Netherlands sanctions on Israeli settlement goods.

en.summary: The Saudi Exchange's market capitalization declined by SAR 8.9 billion week-on-week to approximately SAR 9.299 trillion as of September 24. Foreign investors held 4.73% of total market capital.

en.summary: Saudi Exchange lifted its trading suspension on National Gypsum Co. shares effective September 28, following the company's submission of its first-half 2026 financial statements after missing the regulatory deadline.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority is consulting stakeholders for 30 days on draft regulations governing how capital market institutions conduct business in foreign financial markets, including new suitability requirements.
